name: Carta Investors
description: Carta Investors plugin — skills for querying investor data, performance benchmarks, regulatory reporting, AGM deck generation, brand extraction, and more via the Carta MCP Server.
longDescription:
Ships **16 skills** and **4 hooks**.

- **Skills** (16): `carta-agm-deck-builder` (End-to-end AGM deck generator), `carta-brand-extraction` (Generates a brand board from a firm's website URL and optional user-provided assets), `carta-co-investors` (Interactive co-investor report from Carta SPA data with clickable portfolio drill-downs), `carta-compliance-routing` (Routes to Form ADV for regulatory filing data), `carta-consolidating-balance-sheet` (Generate a consolidating Balance Sheet for all entities under a firm for a given month and write it…), `carta-consolidating-pnl` (Consolidating P&L (Income Statement) across the entities of a firm, for any period the user picks — a…), `carta-download-tearsheet` (Download tear sheets for your portfolio companies and funds on Carta), `carta-explore-data` (PRIMARY and DEFAULT skill for ALL Carta investors data queries — use before any other skill for Carta…), and 8 more
- **Hooks** (4): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PostToolUse`

Installs with `claude plugin install carta-investors@claude-plugins-official` from `carta/plugins` (`plugins/carta-investors`).
